content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Ad-hoc appointment for 89 days or till the regular candidate joins, whichever is earlier Extension up to a maximum of 03 years subject to satisfactory performance, conduct report from HOD and written request from the doctor Total Senior Resident tenure is three years including earlier Senior Resident service Appointments from the second merit list are for one year only and not renewable If a PG SR joins against a seat filled by a non-PG SR, Last come First out rule applies Selected candidates must join within 07 working days of the offer letter or the offer is cancelled

content_sections.heading: How Will SGMH Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Walk-in interview Selection through walk-in-interview only Separate merit lists for fresh candidates and for those who have completed 3 years senior residency Fresh candidates' list exhausted first; second list used only after that If interviews are not completed, they continue on the next working day or a fresh date is announced

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Filled application form with photograph, checklist and two passport size photographs DOB certificate (10th certificate/marksheet) and caste certificate MBBS marksheet and degree/certificate and internship completion certificate DMC registration (MBBS) PG Degree/Diploma marksheet and certificate and attempt certificate Aadhar card; all original certificates and testimonials

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SGMH Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill the application form for the post of Senior Resident enclosed with the notice and paste a recent passport size photograph. Complete the enclosed checklist and attach self-attested copies of certificates in the checklist order. Report at 4th Floor Conference Hall, Administrative Block, SGM Hospital on 16.11.2026 between 9 AM and 12 PM for registration. Bring the documents in photocopy and original; entry is not allowed after 12 PM. Incomplete applications will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Result on www.health.delhigovt.nic.in result section, SGM hospital website and notice board Acceptance of offer to be sent within 48 hours of result by e-mail to [email protected] No TA/DA for appearing in the interview Hostel accommodation is not mandatory and is subject to availability Number of vacancies is tentative and may vary without notice Selected candidates must undertake not to work at any other Government or Private Health Care Facility during tenure

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for SGMH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 16 November 2026, and candidates report at 9:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in SGMH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 38 vacancies: 4 Senior Resident (Medicine), 4 Senior Resident (Surgery), 2 Senior Resident (Orthopaedics), 7 Senior Resident (Paediatrics), 6 Senior Resident (Anaesthesia), 8 Senior Resident (Radiology) and 5 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for SGMH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 16 November 2026 at 9:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 45 years for General (as on date of interview). Relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC 3 years, Persons with disability 5 years extra.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Pay matrix level 11, Rs. 67700-2,08,700 plus allowances for Senior Resident (Medicine), Pay matrix level 11, Rs. 67700-2,08,700 plus allowances for Senior Resident (Surgery), Pay matrix level 11, Rs. 67700-2,08,700 plus allowances for Senior Resident (Orthopaedics), Pay matrix level 11, Rs. 67700-2,08,700 plus allowances for Senior Resident (Paediatrics), Pay matrix level 11, Rs. 67700-2,08,700 plus allowances for Senior Resident (Anaesthesia).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MBBS with P.G. Degree/Diploma/DNB in the concerned specialty from a recognized University/Institution and registration with Delhi Medical Council (or proof of having applied). In shortage specialties, non-PG candidates with 02 years' experience in the specialty may also appear. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Registration with Delhi Medical Council, or proof of having applied for it at the time of walk-in-interview. OBC reservation for OBC from Delhi only; only OBC certificates issued by Govt. of NCT of Delhi accepted. OBC candidates need a valid Non-Creamy Layer Certificate for the current financial year. Candidates already in govt. service should submit a NOC from their employer.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who have completed 03 years Senior Residency in any recognized institution on Regular or Ad-hoc basis, except under the relaxation for shortage specialties.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview. Selection through walk-in-interview only. Separate merit lists for fresh candidates and for those who have completed 3 years senior residency. Fresh candidates' list exhausted first; second list used only after that.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Ad-hoc appointment for 89 days or till the regular candidate joins, whichever is earlier. Extension up to a maximum of 03 years subject to satisfactory performance, conduct report from HOD and written request from the doctor. Total Senior Resident tenure is three years including earlier Senior Resident service.
